name: Clay
thesis: A calm studio, not a gym: warm paper, earthy Kind colors and soft Fraunces digits, so running a class feels like a well-run yoga or pilates room.

layoutChanges.home: The left sidebar becomes a top bar with a centered pill-tab nav and a terracotta New Workout pill; the most recently used Workout becomes a large hero card with Start, and the rest sit in a two-column grid of soft cards below it.
layoutChanges.session: The full-height panel and side rail become one huge rounded Kind-colored window, with Up next as a floating card that overlaps its bottom-right corner, and the control bar becomes a cream pill inside the window; the Interval list slides in as a panel over that corner.
layoutChanges.edit: The outline becomes a vertical spine: Intervals hang off a continuous line on Kind-colored nodes and Groups are rounded bays on ring nodes; Workout settings leaves the column for a right-hand drawer opened from the header, and the selection toolbar floats as a dock at the bottom.
layoutChanges.wizard: The four-across row of cards becomes a 2×2 grid of large cards, each with a giant serif title and a bead-string Timeline beside an arrow.
layoutChanges.library: Level headings become serif chapter headings with a three-step level mark and a hairline rule.
layoutChanges.countdown: The Preset tiles become round pebbles in a gently staggered row, with the Custom card beside them instead of below; the running screen is a rounded window with the control pill centered under the time.
layoutChanges.settings: The two-column card grid becomes one reading column with a sticky section index on the left (a scrolling pill row on narrow screens).
layoutChanges.wizard-style: The fieldsets become cards hanging off a vertical spine with Kind-colored nodes, and the Your Workout card leads with a large label and a giant serif total.
